transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: The centre of Hurghada is about 20 minutes by car. Minibuses to the city wait at the airport exit and leave when full; they have no fixed timetable.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxis wait at the exit from the arrivals area. The fare is agreed with the driver before boarding. Car rental is available, including Hertz.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: The airport has two passenger terminals. The terminals have ATMs and currency exchange points.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Pearl Lounge in terminal 1 is after passport control and security, on Level 2 by gate 30, open round the clock. Sources differ on who is admitted; check entry conditions with the lounge.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: The airport has a left luggage office. Sources do not state where exactly it is or how much it costs.
